queries_run: Texas Instruments largest customer second source in-house chip 2026
Texas Instruments customer concentration no single customer 10% revenue diversified
automaker in-house power management chip design second source Texas Instruments 2026

findings.claim: TI's revenue base is structurally diversified: no single customer accounts for more than 10% of sales, TI sells to more than 100,000 customers, and over 40% of revenue comes from outside its top 100 customers — a structural mitigant against single-customer second-sourcing or in-house insourcing risk that would materially move total revenue.
findings.source: Texas Instruments 2025 Annual Report / Notice of 2026 Annual Meeting (SEC filing, investor.ti.com)

note: No specific named-customer event (a particular OEM publicly announcing second-sourcing away from TI, or insourcing/self-designing an analog or power-management function previously supplied by TI) was found in available search results for 2026. The only sourced fact located is TI's structural lack of customer concentration (no customer >10% of sales), which reduces the blast radius of any single second-sourcing/in-house decision but does not confirm or rule out such activity at any specific account.
